explanation: D2 is always about 10 (9 when an a1 choice reached S1), and GO is 9-10 when the agent picks a2 but 6-8 when it picks a1 (4-6 in the weakest a1 runs). D1 varies most: it is high (7-9) while the agent is on an a2 streak, even after a loss, but when the agent is on a1 it drops to 0-2 right after an unrewarded trial, sits at 3-5 after a reward, and climbs to 7-8 only after a long run of rewarded a1 trials.
